title: Electric Spoons, Chopsticks May Help Cut Salt (2/2)
titleZh: 電子湯匙與筷子或許能幫助減鹽 (2/2)
summaryZh: 日本麒麟公司研發電子餐具，希望在不減風味下幫民眾降低鹽分攝取。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Health & Lifestyle

sentences.text: He has also developed a lickable TV screen that can recreate the taste of food.
sentences.zh: 他還開發出一種可以舔的電視螢幕，能重現食物的味道。

sentences.text: The beer producer Kirin is turning to health care products to expand its traditional business.
sentences.zh: 啤酒製造商麒麟正轉向健康照護產品，想擴展原本的本業。

sentences.text: A company spokesperson said the technology might be especially useful for Japanese people, whose traditional diet favors salty foods.
sentences.zh: 公司發言人表示，這項技術對日本人可能特別有用，因為他們的傳統飲食偏鹹。

sentences.text: The average adult in Japan consumes about 10 grams of salt per day.
sentences.zh: 日本成年人平均每天攝取大約 10 公克的鹽。

sentences.text: The World Health Organization recommends half that amount.
sentences.zh: 世界衛生組織建議的量只有這個數字的一半。

sentences.text: Eating foods with too much sodium can increase the chances of having high blood pressure, strokes, and other health problems.
sentences.zh: 吃太多含鈉量高的食物，會提高罹患高血壓、中風和其他健康問題的機率。

sentences.text: To prevent these diseases, we need to reduce the amount of salt we take, said Kirin researcher Ai Sato.
sentences.zh: 麒麟的研究員佐藤愛說，要預防這些疾病，我們就得減少鹽分的攝取量。

sentences.text: Sato said, it is hard to cut salt in the usual way because it would mean eating bland food.
sentences.zh: 佐藤說，用一般的方法減鹽很難，因為那代表要吃很清淡的食物。
